function: Joint BS downlink beamforming, UL power, AM-RIS amplitude/phase/energy-harvesting configuration, fluid-antenna positions and AAV placement, learned by hybrid DRL to maximize energy efficiency (p. 7)
system: FD-BS with N_T=N_R=16 fluid antennas, 4 single-antenna DL and 4 UL users, 4 AAV-mounted multi-functional RISs (reflecting, amplifying, harvesting; 32 elements), 3.5 GHz (p. 4, p. 12)
method: Multi-agent hybrid DRL: MADQN for discrete and MAPPO for continuous actions, multi-head attention state encoder, meta-PPO agent tuning hyperparameters; reinforcement learning (p. 8, p. 11)
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician BS-RIS and RIS-user links with Rayleigh NLoS, elevation-based LoS probability for the flying RIS, 500x500 m area; no dataset or measurement (p. 5, p. 6, p. 12)
test_conditions: EE reported as converged training performance per setting; sweeps of users, RISs, elements, height, power, residual SI, CSI error; no held-out or unseen scenario described (p. 12, p. 18)
baselines: Learned: SOHRL without attention, hybrid DRL, MAPPO, MATD3, MADDPG, C-PPO, C-DQN. Non-learned: convex optimization (BCD/SCA), hybrid genetic algorithm, random configurations (p. 12, p. 14, p. 18)
metrics: Energy efficiency (bits/Hz/J), achievable rate, power consumption, training time per step, inference latency, memory per agent (p. 12, p. 15, p. 19)
complexity: Order O(3 N_B N_L N_W^2 + N_B N_W (|A_c|+|A_d|+|G|) + N_B 4|S_i| N_W^2 N_H); 6.2 MB memory, 68 ms per training step, 0.42 ms inference (p. 19)
q1_support: p. 5: "modeled as a Rician channel" - custom Rician/Rayleigh model with parameters in Table 3 (p. 12); no 3GPP TR 38.901 model, public ray-tracing dataset or measurement is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 15: "different numbers of UL and DL users" - EE is reported per setting as a sweep; the paper never states that a trained policy is tested in a scenario not used for training, and no transfer or fine-tuning is mentioned.
q3_support: p. 12: "hybrid DRL [37], MAPPO [45]," (learned baselines, also MATD3, MADDPG, C-PPO, C-DQN); p. 18: "conventional convex optimization approaches" (non-learned, with genetic algorithm), both compared on EE.
q4_support: p. 19: "The proposed SOHRL scheme has a complexity order of" - Table 7 gives the order, and the text gives 6.2 MB and 68 ms per training step.
q5_support: p. 12: "and DRL are listed in Table 3." - the paper uses its own simulation parameters; no code or data link, DOI or public channel dataset appears anywhere in the 21 pages.
notes: Area 6 proposed over 3 because the RIS is carried by AAVs (aerial links: elevation-based LoS model p. 6, rotary-wing power model p. 7) and the more specific area wins; area 3 would apply if an aerial RIS inside a terrestrial FD cell is not counted as NTN, so the reviewer should confirm. Passes above_phy because beamforming and RIS configuration are learned jointly with AAV placement (p. 9). Tables 3 and 7 were read from the page images (p. 12, p. 19). Meta-learning in the paper is a PPO agent that adjusts hyperparameters, not cross-scenario meta-training.
